messages:
tara_sec: Auditor asked for evidence that an emergency KMS key rotation we did after a vuln triage is fully traceable: ticket -> PR -> CI apply -> RBAC elevation (if any) -> CloudTrail/KMS events -> runbook approval logs. Need to propose artifacts.
mike_oncall: We can bundle: Jira ticket export, PR diff, CI build log with pipeline ID, kubectl controller logs for role changes, CloudTrail export for KMS/STS events, and full KMS key-rotation history.
auditor_elena: That set sounds good. Also include the chatops command (who ran /why) and the runbook ID/approval chain for break-glass. Staging replay is optional but helpful.
devops_raj: I'll prepare a sanitized incident demo in staging that mirrors prod steps. Will record: the PR apply, the kubectl patch (if any), the runbook run, and the aws kms rotate-key call.
tara_sec: Please paste example extraction commands/queries we should include in the bundle so reviewers can reproduce. Keep them parameterized.
devops_raj: KMS rotation/metadata commands (staging example):
```bash
aws kms describe-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/EX-STAGING 
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/EX-STAGING
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time 2024-11-01 --end-time 2024-11-30 --output json
```
mike_oncall: For RBAC/audit linkage: extract kube-apiserver audit lines and STS assume-role events:
```bash
# kube audit (parametrized)
jq -c 'select(.objectRef.kind=="RoleBinding" or .verb=="patch")' /var/log/kube-apiserver/audit.log | grep staging-incident-binding
# CloudTrail STS events
index=aws_cloudtrail sourcetype=aws:cloudtrail eventName=AssumeRole OR eventName=PutRolePolicy | table _time, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters
```
tara_sec: Good. Auditor also wants chain-of-custody: commit SHA -> pipeline id -> who approved PR -> who ran runbook steps. Include exact CI output lines.
auditor_elena: Also include a short CSV mapping each artifact to the control(s) it addresses (SOC2 CC6, CC7, ISO A.9, A.12 etc.) and a one-line rationale per artifact. No nested documents please.
devops_raj: Note: we'll scrub customer IDs and IPs before export. We'll run infra/tools/scrub-logs.sh and list the sanitizer command in README.
evidence-bot: Uploaded artifact: incident-ticket-4523.json (sanitized). Uploaded artifact: ci-pipeline-4523.log (sanitized).
mike_oncall: Plan: create demo ticket and PR today, run replay in staging tomorrow 9am PT, record a 90s screencast, collect artifacts, assemble mapping.csv and timeline.txt, then hand to auditor for review.
auditor_elena: Timeline and mapping.csv are essential. If you can also provide the exact queries used for extraction as separate .txt files, that'll speed review.
tara_sec: Action items: raj = create demo (PR + staging rotate), mike = capture CI and kube logs, I will assemble mapping.csv + scrub exports. Target: package by tomorrow EOD. If anything unexpected, ping here.
devops_raj: Acknowledged. Will tag the runbook execution with RUNBOOK-2024-INC-9 and include approval emails in the bundle.
mike_oncall: Quick reminder: replace real ARNs with placeholder tokens in mp4 and logs. We'll list replacements in README.
auditor_elena: Thanks team — that plan should give us a clear audit trail for the emergency rotation scenario. Looking forward to the bundle.
